newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- India to release Saudi Arabian aircraft which landed at a military airport in Madras by mistake.
- Industry and electricity minister will lead a delegation of Saudi officials to the Saudi-Indian joint economic commission in India on June 11.
- Japan External Trade Organisation examines opportunities to promote Japanese investments in the kingdom.
- Saudi crown prince holds talks with the Egyptian president on bilateral relations.
- Eastern province governor to open on Wednesday an expansion project of the Saudi Cement Company built at a cost of one billion riyals.
- Transport minister says Saudi Arabia invested 132 billion riyals on roads.
- Ahsa chamber of commerce studies establishing a tourism firm with a capital of 50 million riyals.
